info.title: Prism API
info.description: Revenue cycle metrics for ambulance and fire Providers. Every route needs a signed-in session. Responses are aggregate-only unless a route says otherwise.

get.summary: Liveness
get.description: Returns 200 while the process is running. It never touches the database.

get.summary: Readiness
get.description: Returns 200 when Prism's database accepts connections, otherwise 503 with no detail. The check is shared and cached for 5 seconds.

get.summary: The signed-in user
get.description: Returns the user, the Providers they may see (with how many Facilities each is limited to) and their permissions. Returns 401 when there is no valid session.

post.summary: Open a shared Saved View from an emailed link
post.description: Uses up the invitation `token` from the emailed link and gives the signed-in user read access to that view. The token works once, until it expires, and not after the owner revokes it. The caller must be assigned to the view's Provider. Every failure (unknown, used, expired, revoked or out-of-scope) returns the same 404, so nothing says whether a token, a view or an address exists. Returns the Provider and view to open. Example body: `{"token":"<43 characters from the link>"}`.

get.summary: Net cash collected by month
get.description: Net cash collected for the Provider in each of the last `months` accounting periods ending with `endPeriod`, from the latest warehouse load. `endPeriod` is `yyyyMM` and defaults to the newest period that has data. `months` defaults to 6 and is at most 24. `serviceLine` is `all` (default, the Provider's whole figure), `air` or `ground`: air or ground alone is added up from the payments ledger by the transport's level of service, because the warehouse's summary table has no such split. Months with no data are left out, not returned as zero. The figures are aggregates: no patient or claim detail. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full (not assigned, or limited to some Facilities).

get.summary: Projected net cash for the next one to three months
get.description: The cash the warehouse forecasts for up to three months after `endPeriod` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data), from the latest forecast load. `serviceLine` is `all` (default), `air` or `ground`. `horizon` (1 to 3, default 3) is how many months to return: the forecast table holds only the next three months, so anything outside 1 to 3 is a 400. Each month also reports the two components the warehouse forecasts, as read: `fromExistingTrips` (expected collections on trips that already existed) and `fromFutureTrips` (assumed run rate of trips that do not exist yet), with `existingTripsShare` and `futureTripsShare` (0 to 1, null when the month's value is zero or the component is missing). They are not assumed to add up to `value`, and a trip that already existed may not be billed yet. Service Line is the only filter: the forecast table has no Reporting Division, call type, aircraft or payer column, so none is offered. Each month has the projected `value` and a likely range (`low` to `high`): the lower and higher of the total and the two components. That range is a product rule (the lower and higher of the total and the two components), not a statistical interval or confidence band. Each month also has `changeFromPrevious` (`amount` in USD and `percent`, null when the base is zero) and a running `cumulative` (`value`, `low`, `high`) from the first returned month. The first month is compared with `latestActual`, the latest month with posted net cash within the six months up to `endPeriod`; `changeFromPrevious` is null on the first month, and `latestActual` is null, when there is none. `horizon` totals the returned months (`value`, `low`, `high`, `months`), and `total`, `low` and `high` are the same sums. Fewer months than asked for, or none, come back when the forecast is shorter. Aggregates only. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Net cash by aircraft type or level of service
get.description: Net cash collected in `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) and the month before it, split by aircraft type (air) or level of service (ground), and by Reporting Division and vehicle (tail number or unit). `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. Net cash is payments less refunds by the accounting period they posted in, without the Old AR import, so the groups add up to the net cash for the period. `transports` are the encounters with cash posted in the period. Legacy Old AR bases are counted under their current Reporting Division. Aggregates only: no patient or claim detail. Each group has `links`: a `drill` link to the payer mix of that group, issued by the server for this Provider and these filters. `division` limits the figures to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Transports by primary payer group
get.description: Transports by the primary payer's group for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) and the month before it, by date of service. `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type or level of service, using the `key` the breakdown route returns (for example `fixed-wing`). Groups are Commercial (insurance and third-party liability), Medicare (with Medicare Advantage), Medicaid (with Medicaid managed care), Other government, VA (VA, CHAMPVA and TRICARE payers by name), Facility and Patient responsibility. `not-recorded` appears only when some transports have no payer. Counts only: no patient, claim or payer names. Each share has `links`: a `drill` link to the payers inside Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Other government and VA, issued by the server for this Provider and these filters, and none for the other groups. `division` limits the figures to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Net cash by payer and payment age
get.description: Net cash for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) and the twelve months before it, by payer group, posting month and payment age. Payment age is the number of months between the transport's date of service and the month the cash posted, so 0 is cash for a transport flown that month, and ages above 24 are counted at 24. Net cash is payments less refunds by posting month, without the Old AR import, as in the breakdown. Cash for transports with no date of service is left out, so the cells can add up to less than the breakdown. `payers` summarises each payer group over all the cells: `typicalAgeMonths` is the cash-weighted median age in months (null when the group has no cash) and `bands` is the share (0 to 1, four decimals, summing to 1 within rounding) of the group's cash received at ages 0-1, 2-3, 4-6, 7-12 and 13+ months (empty when no cash). Age is whole months only (posting month minus date-of-service month, capped at 24): the warehouse has no day-level payment date, so no day figures are given. Refunds (negative cells) are left out of the typical age and the shares. `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type or level of service, using the `key` the breakdown route returns (for example `fixed-wing`). Aggregates only: no patient, claim or payer names. `division` limits the figures to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Matured net cash per transport by payer
get.description: What a transport earns by primary payer group, for transports old enough to have been paid. The cohorts are the twelve date-of-service months that ended at least six months before `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data), returned as `cohortFrom` and `cohortThrough`. For each payer group: the `transports` in the cohorts (paid or not), the net `cash` posted for them up to and including `period` (payments less refunds, without the Old AR import), and `cashPerTransport`, which is null when the group has no transports. `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type or level of service, using the `key` the breakdown route returns (for example `fixed-wing`). Every payer group is listed in a fixed order, with zeros. `overall` is the matured net cash per transport across all payer groups for the same cohorts, `serviceLine` and `division`, without the `group` filter; each payer group has `differenceFromOverall` (USD) and `percentFromOverall` (percent units, null when overall is zero or missing). `cohorts` names the service months (`firstServiceMonth` to `lastServiceMonth`, 12 months matured by 6) and the payment period (`cashThroughPeriod`) used. Aggregates only: no patient, claim or payer names. `division` limits the figures to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Net cash by month and aircraft type or level of service
get.description: Net cash collected by posting month for each aircraft type (air) or level of service (ground), for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) and the twelve months before it. Net cash is payments less refunds by the accounting period they posted in, without the Old AR import, so a group's month matches the same group in the breakdown. `transports` are the encounters with cash posted in the month. Months with no cash are left out, not returned as zero. Cash for an encounter with no Transport record has no group and is left out. `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. Aggregates only: no patient or claim detail. `division` limits the figures to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Transports and loaded miles by month
get.description: Transports and loaded miles (statute miles, billed with the patient on board) for each of the last `months` months ending with `endPeriod` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data), by date of service. `months` defaults to 6 and is at most 24. `serviceLine` is `all` (default), `air` or `ground`. Months with no transports are left out. `groups` splits the last month by aircraft type or level of service, with each group's `priorTransports` in the month before it (same date-of-service basis, `serviceLine` and `division`), `changeTransports` and `changePercent` (percent units, one decimal, null when the prior month had none). A group with no transports in the last month is not listed. `periodOpen` is true while the accounting period of the last month is open, so transports for it may still be added. A transport belongs to the month it happened, so these counts differ from the net cash breakdown, which counts encounters with cash posted in the month. Aggregates only. `division` limits the figures to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Clean claim rate by month
get.description: The share of claims accepted first time, by month of service, for each of the last `months` months up to `endPeriod` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) that the warehouse has a figure for. `months` defaults to 6 and is at most 24. `rate` is 0 to 1, or null when there were no claims. Months the warehouse has no figure for are left out, so the newest point can be older than `endPeriod`: the warehouse table is refreshed on its own schedule. The figure covers all of the Provider's claims, not one Service Line. Aggregates only. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Transports by payer within one payer group
get.description: The payers behind one group of the payer mix, reached from the `drill` link on a payer mix share. `payerKey` is `commercial`, `medicare`, `medicaid`, `other-gov` or `va`; `patient`, `facility`, `not-recorded` and any other value are a 404, because those groups have no payers to compare. `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data), `serviceLine` (`all`, `air` (default) or `ground`), `group` and `division` mean what they do on the payer mix route and give the same Transports, so the rows add up to that group's share there. `payers` are the 10 payers with the most transports in the month and the month before, then one `Other` row for the rest. A payer name is the warehouse's text, trimmed, with control characters removed and cut to 120 characters. Counts only: no patient or claim data. An unknown `division` key is a 400. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Transports by call type
get.description: Transports by call type for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) and the month before it, by date of service. A call type is `scene` or `interfacility` for air and `emergency` or `non-emergency` for ground, from the response type of the transport, and `not-recorded` when the warehouse has none. Each call type has its transports, `share` of all transports (0 to 1) and `changePoints` (percentage points against the month before), loaded miles (statute), the payer mix of its transports (`payerMix`, share by payer group of that call type) and `netCash`. `netCash` is net cash posted in the month (payments less refunds by posting month, without the Old AR import) for the encounters of that call type. It is on a different basis from the transport counts, which are by date of service, so do not divide one by the other as an expected payment. Expected payment per transport is not available in the warehouse and is not estimated. `trend` has one point per month for the last `months` months (6, the default, or 12) ending with `period`, with the transports and share of each call type. `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type or level of service, using a `key` from the breakdown route. `division` limits the figures to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Aggregates only. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Performance by tail number
get.description: Transports, loaded miles and net cash for each tail number (the warehouse's vehicle) for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) and the month before it, with the change from the month before. Transports and loaded miles (statute) are by date of service. `netCash` is net cash posted in the month (payments less refunds by posting month, without the Old AR import) for encounters that have a trip row. `netCashPerTransport` is posting-month net cash divided by date-of-service transports: a ratio of two bases, not the expected payment of a transport, and null when there were no transports. The 100 tail numbers with the most transports are listed and one `Other` row (`isOther` true) sums the rest. A transport with no tail is under `Not recorded`. Tail text comes from the warehouse: it is trimmed, control characters are removed and it is cut to 120 characters. This Metric is air only: `serviceLine` `air` (default) and `all` both mean air, and `ground` is a 400. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type, using a `key` from the breakdown route. `division` limits the figures to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Aggregates only. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Figures by Reporting Division
get.description: Transports, loaded miles and net cash for each Reporting Division for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) and the month before it, with the change from the month before. Transports and loaded miles (statute) are by date of service. `netCash` is net cash posted in the month (payments less refunds by posting month, without the Old AR import) for encounters that have a trip row. `netCashPerTransport` is posting-month net cash divided by date-of-service transports: a ratio of two bases, not the expected payment of a transport, and null when there were no transports. Each division has its `key` (from the divisions route, null for the Other row, for transports with no division and for a name the directory does not hold), the warehouse's `name` (a legacy `- Old AR` suffix is folded into the current division) and `aircraft`: the tail numbers that flew from it in `period` with their transport counts, the 10 largest plus one `Other` entry. The 100 divisions with the most transports are listed and one `Other` row sums the rest (it lists no aircraft). Aggregate counts only. `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type or level of service, using a `key` from the breakdown route. `division` limits it to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Loaded miles by tail number
get.description: Loaded miles (statute miles billed with the patient on board), transports and the average loaded miles per transport for each tail number (the warehouse's vehicle) in `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data), by date of service. `averageLoadedMiles` is null when the tail had no transports in the month. `trend` has one point per month for the last `months` months (6, the default, or 12) ending with `period`, with transports, loaded miles and the average (null for a month with no transports). Tails are ranked by their loaded miles in `period`. The 100 largest are listed and one `Other` row (`isOther` true) sums the rest, including its trend. A transport with no tail is under `Not recorded`. Tail text comes from the warehouse: it is trimmed, control characters are removed and it is cut to 120 characters. This Metric is air only: `serviceLine` `air` (default) and `all` both mean air, and `ground` is a 400. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type, using a `key` from the breakdown route. `division` limits the figures to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Aggregates only. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Expected cash effect of the payer mix
get.description: The expected effect on cash of the change in payer mix between `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) and the month before. For each payer group the effect is its change in share of transports (by date of service), times what a transport of that group has earned once matured (`cashPerTransport`, the same measure as the cash per transport route), times the transports of `period`. It is an expected effect, not posted cash (`basis` is `expected`): payer mix is by date of service and cash posts later. `estimatedEffect` is the sum over the payer groups and `recurringMonthlyEffect` is the same number, on the assumption that the shift persists every month. A group's `cashPerTransport` and `effect` are null when it had no matured transports; `estimatedEffect` and `recurringMonthlyEffect` are null when no group has an effect or either month had no transports. `share`, `priorShare` are fractions (0 to 1) and `changePoints` is in percentage points. `cohorts` gives the date-of-service months behind the matured cash per transport. The Insight on the dashboard uses the same calculation. `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type or level of service, using a `key` from the breakdown route. `division` limits it to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Aggregates only. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Transports by pickup location
get.description: Transports by where the patient was picked up for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) and the month before it, by date of service. The pickup `sources` come from the origin modifier on the claim: `scene` (S), `residence` (R), `custodial-facility` (E), `hospital` (H), `skilled-nursing` (N), `physician-office` (P), `transfer-site` (I), `diagnostic-site` (D), `dialysis` (G and J) and `other` (anything else, blank or not a single letter). This mapping is general CMS ambulance billing knowledge, to be confirmed against the warehouse values. Each source has its transports, `share` of all transports (0 to 1) and `changePoints` (percentage points against the month before), loaded miles (statute), the payer mix of its transports and `netCash` (net cash posted in the month by posting month, a different basis from the date-of-service counts). `facilities` lists the sending facilities of the facility-based sources (hospital, skilled nursing, physician office, transfer site, diagnostic site, dialysis): the 20 with the most transports across the whole result and one `Other` row (`isOther` true, no `sourceKey`) for the rest. Scene, residence, custodial facility and other pickups are never broken down by name, and no address, city, state or zip is ever returned. Facility text comes from the warehouse: it is trimmed, control characters are removed and it is cut to 120 characters. `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type or level of service, using a `key` from the breakdown route. `division` limits it to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Aggregates only. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Cash change by tail number
get.description: How much each tail number added to (positive `change`) or took from (negative) the change in net cash for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) against the month before. Net cash is posted cash: payments less refunds by posting month, without the Old AR import, for encounters that have a trip row. `total` is the net cash of the scope and the `rows`, the `Other` row included, add up exactly to it, so the contributions always add up to `total.change`. Each row is a tail number (the warehouse's vehicle): `key` and `name` are the cleaned tail text (trimmed, control characters removed, cut to 120 characters), `Not recorded` for a transport with no tail. The 25 tail numbers that moved cash most (by absolute change) are listed and one `Other` row (`isOther` true) sums the rest. This Metric is air only: `serviceLine` `air` (default) and `all` both mean air, and `ground` is a 400. `shareOfChange` is a row's change divided by the total change, null when the total did not change, and can be above 1 or below 0 when contributors offset each other. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type or level of service, using a `key` from the breakdown route. `division` limits it to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Aggregates only: no patient or claim detail. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Cash change by Reporting Division
get.description: How much each Reporting Division added to (positive `change`) or took from (negative) the change in net cash for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) against the month before. Net cash is posted cash: payments less refunds by posting month, without the Old AR import, for encounters that have a trip row. `total` is the net cash of the scope and the `rows`, the `Other` row included, add up exactly to it, so the contributions always add up to `total.change`. Each row is a Reporting Division: `key` is from the divisions route (null for the Other row, for transports with no division, whose `name` is `Not recorded`, and for a name the directory does not hold) and `name` is the warehouse's name with a legacy `- Old AR` suffix folded into the current division. The 25 divisions that moved cash most are listed and one `Other` row sums the rest. `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. `shareOfChange` is a row's change divided by the total change, null when the total did not change, and can be above 1 or below 0 when contributors offset each other. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type or level of service, using a `key` from the breakdown route. `division` limits it to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Aggregates only: no patient or claim detail. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Cash change by payer group
get.description: How much each payer group added to (positive `change`) or took from (negative) the change in net cash for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) against the month before. Net cash is posted cash: payments less refunds by posting month, without the Old AR import, for encounters that have a trip row. `total` is the net cash of the scope and the `rows`, the `Other` row included, add up exactly to it, so the contributions always add up to `total.change`. Each row is a payer group by the primary payer of the transport the cash was posted against: `commercial`, `medicare`, `medicaid`, `other-gov`, `va`, `facility`, `patient` or `not-recorded`. No payer name is returned. `serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`. `shareOfChange` is a row's change divided by the total change, null when the total did not change, and can be above 1 or below 0 when contributors offset each other. A payer group that has detail carries a `drill` link to its payer detail. `group` narrows it to one aircraft type or level of service, using a `key` from the breakdown route. `division` limits it to one Reporting Division, using a `key` from the divisions route; an unknown key is a 400. Aggregates only: no patient or claim detail. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: Accounting periods with net cash data
get.description: The accounting periods the Provider has net cash data for, newest first, as `yyyyMM` with a display label. Fills the Period drop-down.

get.summary: Reporting Divisions of the Provider
get.description: The Reporting Divisions the Provider's transports are filed under in the latest warehouse load, in name order, each with the stable `key` that the `division` query parameter of the Transport-based Metrics accepts and the warehouse's `name` for it. A division that only exists under a legacy "- Old AR" name is listed under its current name. At most 500 are returned. Names and keys only, no counts and no patient data. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: The Metric Catalog
get.description: Every Metric a Saved View can show, grouped by `categories`. `status` is `available` or `planned`: a planned Metric is listed so the palette can show it as coming soon, and cannot be placed. `placeable` is false for something computed on the dashboard only, such as `what_changed`. `dimensions` are the filters the Metric honors (`period`, `months`, `serviceLine`, `group`, `division`); a Metric that does not list `division` ignores the Reporting Division filter. `presentations` are the ways it can be drawn, each with the preset sizes (`S`, `M`, `L`) that suit it and its bounds in columns and rows of the 12-column grid. `options` are the settings a widget exposes, as `choice` or `toggle`. `claimLevel` marks a Metric that would carry claim detail and so stays planned until it has its own permission and an audit record. `context` says where the Metric applies: `providerScoped`, `serviceLines`, `divisionSupport` (`none` or `supported`), `groupDimensions`, `timeGrain` (`period` or `month`) and `appliesTo` (`air`, `ground` or `both`: an air-only Metric treats `serviceLine=all` as air and refuses `serviceLine=ground` with a 400). `freshness.policy` is `dailyLoad` (cached against Data Through) or `noCache` (claim-level). `helpKey` names the Metric's help entry, and `drills` lists links to other Metrics. Definitions only: no figures, and the same for every Provider the caller can read.

get.summary: What changed in net cash against the month before
get.description: Explains the change in posted net cash for `period` (`yyyyMM`, default the newest period with net cash data) against the month before, for one aircraft type or level of service (`group`, a `key` from the breakdown route such as `fixed-wing`) or the whole Service Line (`serviceLine` is `all`, `air` (default) or `ground`). `drivers` are the findings that explain part of the posted change, largest first, and with `remainder` they add up to `delta`. `expected` are findings on another basis, such as what a shift in payer mix is expected to do to cash as claims are paid, or a shift of transports between Reporting Divisions that is another view of a change already explained by aircraft type, and are not part of `delta`. The findings are `aged-payments`, `volume`, `payer-mix`, `aircraft-mix` (transports moving between aircraft types or levels of service that earn different amounts, a driver) and `base-mix` (the same between Reporting Divisions: a driver only when no aircraft mix explains the change, otherwise listed in `expected`). `remainder.judgment` is `withinNormalRange` only when the unexplained part is inside the usual month-to-month range of the last twelve months, `outsideNormalRange` when it is not, and `notEnoughHistory` when there are not twelve months to judge by. `normalizedDeltaRatio` is the change with unusually high aged payments taken out of both months, or null when there were none. Every figure in the text comes from a finding. Aggregates only: no patient, claim or payer names. Returns 204 when neither month has cash to explain, and 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: How many claims each Attention Check flags
get.description: For `period` (`yyyyMM`, required) and `serviceLine` (`all`, `air` or `ground`, default `all`) and optionally `group` (an aircraft type or level of service key from the breakdown route, such as `fixed-wing`), the number of claims flagged by each Attention Check (`denied`, `needs_attention`, `all`), by date of service in the latest warehouse load, and the balance still owed on the denied claims. Aggregates only, but it needs the claims permission. It also returns `deniedRate` (denied claims divided by all claims in the period, 0 to 1, null when there are none); `reasons` (the top 10 denial reasons by denied claim count, each with `count` and `balanceDue`, then one `isOther` row for the rest; reason text is cleaned in SQL, cut to 120 characters, and empty is `No reason given`); `categories` (separate counts and balance due for Denied, On hold and In collections, which can overlap, so do not add them); and `filingBands` (needs-attention claims and balance due that are past due, due within 10 days, within 30 days, and later, from the derived filing deadline and Data Through; the filing limits are a placeholder until the real payer limits are supplied, so the bands are estimates). There is no assigned owner, and no IDR, patient-due or missing-documentation category: the warehouse has no source for them. The response is never cached. Returns 404 when the Provider is not one the caller may read in full.

get.summary: The claims one Attention Check flags
get.description: The claims flagged by `checkKey` (`denied`, `needs_attention` or `all`) for `period` (`yyyyMM`, required), `serviceLine` and optionally `group`, soonest estimated filing deadline first. `page` starts at 1 and `pageSize` is at most 100. `balanceDue` is what is still owed, not an estimate of what will be paid. `filingDueDate` is an estimate: the date of service plus a filing limit for the payer category, and `daysLeft` counts from `dataThrough`. Claim data is PHI: it needs the claims permission and the read is audited. More than 10,000 matching claims returns 422. Returns 404 for an unknown Provider or check.

get.summary: Download the claims one Attention Check flags as CSV
get.description: The same claims, in the same order, as the list route, as a CSV file with every cell quoted and spreadsheet formulas neutralized. The file name is built from the check and the date only. Claim data is PHI: it needs the claims permission and the download is audited. More than 10,000 matching claims returns 422.

get.summary: The caller's Saved Views and the ones shared with them
get.description: `mine` are the views the caller owns and `shared` the ones shared with them, each by name. A list never includes a layout. Up to 200 of each, by name.

post.description: Creates a view owned by the caller. `name` is 1 to 80 characters and unique among the caller's views in this Provider. `layout` is `{"version":1,"density":"comfortable","widgets":[{"id":"w1","metricKey":"net_collections","presentation":"line","options":{"months":"6"},"x":0,"y":0,"w":6,"h":3}]}`: at most 24 widgets on 12 columns, each a Metric from the catalog that is available and placeable, drawn one of the ways the catalog allows, with options and sizes the catalog allows. A bad layout returns 400 with codes and never the values sent. An `ownerId` or `providerId` in the body is ignored. At most 100 views per owner and Provider.

get.summary: One Saved View with its layout
get.description: The view if the caller owns it or it was shared with them, otherwise 404 (a view that is missing, in another Provider or not theirs look the same). `isOwner` is false for a recipient, who can open it but not change it. The `ETag` header is the version to send back as `If-Match` when saving.

put.description: Owner only. Send the `ETag` you loaded as `If-Match`: if the view was saved by someone else since, the answer is 412 and nothing changes. Without `If-Match` the answer is 428. Same body rules as creating a view.

delete.description: Owner only. Removes the view with its recipients and pending invitations. Recipients lose access at once.

post.summary: Email an invitation to open a view
post.description: Owner only. Emails each address in `emails` (at most 10 a request) a link that works once and expires. Example body: `{"emails":["colleague@example.org"]}`. An address with a pending invitation gets a fresh one and the old link stops working. The email names the view and the sender only. `sent` are the invitations made and `failed` the addresses whose email could not be sent (their invitations are revoked). A view has at most 50 recipients and pending invitations, and an owner can send 30 an hour. Returns 503 when invitations are not turned on for this host or no email could be sent.

get.summary: Who can open a view, and the invitations still waiting
get.description: Owner only. `recipients` have redeemed an invitation (`email` is the address it went to). `pending` have not been used, revoked or (when `isExpired`) have run out.

delete.description: Owner only. The recipient can no longer open the view.
Owner only. The emailed link stops working.

AircraftMilesPointResponse.description: One month of a tail's trend. `AverageLoadedMiles` is null when there were no transports.

AircraftMilesRowResponse.description:
One tail number. `Transports`, `LoadedMiles` and `AverageLoadedMiles` (one decimal, null with no transports) are for `Period`. `Trend` has one point per month of the window,
oldest first, with zeros for a month the tail did not fly.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

AircraftPerformanceResponse.description: Transports, loaded miles and net cash by tail number for `Period` and the month before it. `Totals` adds up every row including Other.

AircraftRowResponse.description: One tail number. `Tail` is warehouse text (cleaned, at most 120 characters), `Not recorded` or `Other` when `IsOther` is true.

AmountChangeResponse.description: A change in USD (`Amount`) and in percent units (`Percent`, 12.5 is 12.5%, one decimal; null when the base is zero).

AttentionCategoryResponse.description: A category of claim needing action: `Key` is `denied`, `on_hold` or `in_collections`. `BalanceDue` (USD) adds only positive balances.

AttentionClaimResponse.description: One flagged claim. Every field is PHI: it can identify a patient's claim.

AttentionClaimsResponse.description: One page of the claims a check flags.

AttentionCountResponse.description: One check and how many claims it flags.

deniedRate.description: Denied claims divided by all claims in the period, 0 to 1 (four decimals). Null when the period has no claims.

reasons.description: The top 10 denial reasons by denied claim count, then one `isOther` row for the rest. Text is cleaned and at most 120 characters.

categories.description: Denied, On hold and In collections, each with its claim count and balance due. A claim can be in more than one, so they overlap and must not be added.

filingBands.description: Needs-attention claims by estimated filing deadline: past due, within 10 days, 11 to 30 days, later. Always four rows, in that order.

AttentionCountsResponse.description: The number of claims each Attention Check flags in a period, with the denial rate, reasons, categories and filing bands. Aggregates only.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

BaseAnalysisResponse.description: Transports, loaded miles and net cash by Reporting Division for `Period` and the month before it. `Totals` adds up every row including Other.

BreakdownFiguresResponse.description:
Net cash (`Cash`, USD), `Transports` (encounters with cash posted in the month) and `LoadedMiles`.
`PrimaryMix` and `SecondaryMix` are scene and interfacility transports for air, emergency and non-emergency for ground.

BreakdownGroupResponse.description:
An aircraft type or level of service. `Key` is stable, `Name` is for display, `ServiceLine` is `air` or `ground`.
`Links` are the drills the server offers for this group (`rel` `drill`, to the payer mix of the group). It is empty when the caller may not read the target.

BreakdownRowResponse.description: A vehicle (tail number or unit) at a Reporting Division (a base or station). `Base` is its name, null when the warehouse has none.

CallTypeResponse.description:
One call type. `Share` and `PriorShare` are fractions (0 to 1, four decimals) of all transports, null when there were none. `ChangePoints` is the move of the share in percentage points
(one decimal), null when either month had none. `NetCash` and `PriorNetCash` are by posting month, a different basis from the date-of-service counts.

CallTypeTrendPointResponse.description: One month of the trend: all transports and the transports and share of each call type.

CallTypeTrendShareResponse.description: A call type in one month of the trend. `Share` is a fraction (0 to 1) of that month's transports, null when there were none.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

CashContributionResponse.description:
How much each contributor added to or took from the change in net cash (USD) for `Period` against `PriorPeriod`. `Total` is net cash for the scope and the rows, the
`Other` row included, add up exactly to its `netCash`, `priorNetCash` and `change`.

CashPerTransportCohortsResponse.description: The service months of the cohorts (`FirstServiceMonth` to `LastServiceMonth`, `yyyyMM`) and the last posting month whose cash is counted (`CashThroughPeriod`).

oneOf.description: The all-payer cash per transport for the same cohorts, Service Line and Division, without the `group` filter. Null when there is no period.
The service period and payment period behind the figures. Null when there is no period.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

CashPerTransportResponse.description:
Matured net cash per transport by payer group for `Period`. The cohorts are the transports flown from `CohortFrom` to `CohortThrough`.
`Group` is set when the figures are for one aircraft type or level of service.

CatalogCategoryResponse.description: A palette group. `Key` is stable, `Name` is for display.

CatalogContextResponse.description:
Where a Metric applies. `DivisionSupport` is `none` or `supported`, `TimeGrain` is `period` or `month`. `AppliesTo` is `air`, `ground` or `both`:
an air-only or ground-only Metric has data for that Service Line only, so `serviceLine=all` means that line and the other line is a 400.
`ServiceLines` lists the `serviceLine` values it accepts: air and both, ground and both, or air, ground and both.

CatalogDrillResponse.description: A link to another Metric: `Rel` names it, `TargetKey` is the Metric, `BindsDimension` is the dimension the clicked value fills.

CatalogMetricResponse.description: One Metric. `Key` is the stable identifier a layout stores. `Status` is `available` or `planned`.

CatalogOptionResponse.description: A widget setting. `Type` is `choice` or `toggle`, `Default` is one of `Choices` for a choice, or `true` or `false` for a toggle.

CatalogPresentationResponse.description: A way to draw a Metric, with its preset sizes and its bounds on the 12-column grid.

CleanClaimPointResponse.description: One month of service: claims accepted first time, rejected, the total, and `Rate` (0 to 1, null when there were no claims).

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

CleanClaimRateResponse.description:
The clean claim rate by month of service up to `EndPeriod`. `Points` only has months the warehouse has a figure for, so the newest can be older than
`EndPeriod`. `SnapshotDate` is the warehouse load the figures came from.

ContributionRowResponse.description:
One contributor. `Change` is its net cash minus its net cash the month before: positive added to the total change, negative took from it. `ShareOfChange` is
`change` divided by the total change (four decimals), null when the total did not change. Shares can be above 1 or below 0 when contributors offset each other.
`Key` is null for the Other row, for a division with no key in the directory and for transports with no division. `Links` are the drills the server issues.

ContributionTotalResponse.description: Net cash in the month and the month before and the change between them, with the change as percent units (one decimal, null when the month before had no cash).

DenialReasonResponse.description: A denial reason (`Reason`, cleaned warehouse text, or `No reason given`), the denied claims behind it and their `BalanceDue` (USD). `IsOther` is the row that sums the reasons beyond the top 10.

DivisionRowResponse.description: One Reporting Division. `Key` is null for the Other row, for transports with no division (`Name` is `Not recorded`) and for a name the directory does not hold. `Aircraft` is empty for the Other row.

DivisionTailResponse.description: A tail number operating from a division, with its transports in the period (date of service). `IsOther` marks the entry that sums the division's other tails.

EffectCohortsResponse.description: The date-of-service months (`yyyyMM`) behind the matured cash per transport, and the last posting month counted.

FigureResponse.description:
Transports and loaded miles by date of service and net cash by posting month, in the month and the month before, with the changes. `ChangePercent` values are percent units
(one decimal), null when the month before had none. `NetCashPerTransport` is posting-month cash divided by transports, null when there were no transports. It is not an expected payment.

FilingBandResponse.description: A filing band: `Key` is `past_due`, `due_within_10_days`, `due_within_30_days` or `due_later`. `Claims` and `BalanceDue` (USD) are for needs-attention claims.

InsightCardResponse.description:
One finding. `Kind` is a stable key (`aged-payments`, `volume`, `payer-mix`). `Label` is `temporary`, `structural`, `watch` or `info`.
`Impact` is USD and signed: negative lowered cash, or is expected to.

InviteRequest.description: The addresses to invite, at most 10.

LayoutWidget.description: One Metric on the grid. It names a Metric by key and says how to draw it and where. It never carries a value, a Label or a filter.

LinkResponse.description: A link the server issues: `Rel` names the relation (such as `drill`), `Href` is a same-origin path, `Title` is for display.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

LoadedMilesByAircraftResponse.description: Loaded miles by tail number for `Period`, with a monthly trend over `Months` months (6 or 12).

MetricCatalogResponse.description: The catalog: `Categories` in palette order and every `Metrics` entry.

MetricResponse.description: What a Metric is: stable key, display name, meaning and unit.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

NetCashBreakdownResponse.description:
Net cash for `Period` and the month before it (`PriorPeriod`), by `Groups` (aircraft type or level of service) and `Rows` (Reporting Division and vehicle).
`PeriodOpen` is true while the accounting period is still open: cash is still posting into it, so the figures are not final.

NetCashByGroupPointResponse.description: Cash (USD) posted in `Period` for one group, from `Transports` encounters. `GroupKey` is stable, `GroupName` is for display.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

NetCashByGroupResponse.description: Net cash by posting month for each group, for `Period` and the twelve months before it.

NetCashProjectionActualResponse.description: An actual month of posted net cash: `Period` is `yyyyMM`, `Value` USD.

NetCashProjectionHorizonResponse.description: The total over the returned months, and how many months that is.

NetCashProjectionMonthResponse.description:
One projected month: `Period` is `yyyyMM`, `Value` the projected cash, `Low` to `High` the likely range (a product rule, not a statistical interval).
`FromExistingTrips` and `FromFutureTrips` (USD, null when missing) are the warehouse's expected collections on trips that already existed and assumed run rate of trips that do not exist yet,
as read, with each one's share (0 to 1) of `Value` (null when `Value` is zero or the component is null). They are not assumed to sum to `Value`.
`ChangeFromPrevious` is null when there is no previous month to compare with. `Cumulative` adds the months up to and including this one.

horizon.description: The total of the returned months: `Value`, `Low`, `High` and how many `Months` that is.

oneOf.description: The latest month with posted net cash that the first projected month is compared with. Null when there is none.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

NetCashProjectionResponse.description: The cash forecast for the months after `AfterPeriod`. `Total`, `Low` and `High` are sums over `Months`.

NetCashProjectionRunningResponse.description: A running sum of the projected value and its likely range.

NetCollectionsPointResponse.description: One month: `Period` is `yyyyMM`, `Label` the short month name, `Value` the amount in the Metric's unit.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

NetCollectionsResponse.description: Net cash collected for a Provider, by accounting period.

OverallCashPerTransportResponse.description: Transports, net cash and cash per transport (USD, null when no transports) across every payer group, never narrowed to one aircraft type or level of service.

PayerCashPerTransportResponse.description:
A payer group: `Key` is stable, `Name` is for display. `CashPerTransport` (USD) is null when there are no transports.
`DifferenceFromOverall` (USD) is this group's figure minus `overall.cashPerTransport`, and `PercentFromOverall` that difference in percent units of the overall figure
(one decimal). The difference is null when the group or the overall figure has no transports, and the percent is also null when the overall figure is zero.

PayerEffectResponse.description:
One payer group. `Share` and `PriorShare` are fractions (0 to 1, four decimals) of that month's transports, null when it had none. `ChangePoints` is the move in percentage points.
`CashPerTransport` is matured net cash per transport (USD), and `Effect` the expected effect on this month's cash (USD). Both are null when the group has no matured transports or either month had none.

PayerGroupResponse.description: The payer group the detail is for: `Key` is stable, `Name` is for display.

PayerMixDetailPayerResponse.description: A payer: `Name` is the warehouse's text (or `Other` for the rest), `Current` and `Prior` are transport counts.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

PayerMixDetailResponse.description:
The payers inside one payer group of the payer mix for `Period` and the month before it (`PriorPeriod`), by date of service.
`Group` and `GroupName` are set when the figures are for one aircraft type or level of service.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

PayerMixFinancialEffectResponse.description:
The expected effect of the payer mix on cash for `Period` against the month before. `Basis` is always `expected`: it is not posted cash. `EstimatedEffect` is the sum of the group effects (USD, null when it cannot be worked out)
and `RecurringMonthlyEffect` is the same number, which holds each month only if the shift persists.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

PayerMixResponse.description:
Transports by primary payer group for `Period` and the month before it (`PriorPeriod`), by date of service. `Group` and `GroupName`
are set when the figures are for one aircraft type or level of service.

PayerMixShareResponse.description:
A payer group: `Key` is stable, `Name` is for display, `Current` and `Prior` are transport counts. `Links` are the drills the server
offers for this group (`rel` `drill`, to the payers inside it). It is empty for Facility, Patient responsibility and Not recorded.

PayerPaymentAgeResponse.description: A payer group's `TypicalAgeMonths` (cash-weighted median, null when no cash) and `Bands` (empty when no cash).

PayerShareResponse.description: A payer group's transports inside one slice, and its share of that slice (0 to 1, four decimals, null when the slice had none) in the month and the month before.

PaymentAgeBandResponse.description: One age band in whole months: `FromMonths` to `ToMonths` inclusive (null for the open-ended last band) and the `Share` (0 to 1) of the group's cash in it.

PaymentAgeCellResponse.description:
Cash (`Cash`, USD) posted in `PostingPeriod` for `Transports` transports of payer group `PayerKey` that were `AgeMonths` months old
when paid. `PayerKey` is stable, `PayerName` is for display.

payers.description: Per payer group, over all the cells: the typical age (months) and the share of cash by age band. Payer groups with no cells are not listed.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

PaymentAgeResponse.description:
Net cash by payer group, posting month and payment age for `Period` and the twelve months before it. `Group` is set when the figures are
for one aircraft type or level of service.

PickupFacilityResponse.description: A sending facility (warehouse text, cleaned, at most 120 characters), or the one `Other` row (`SourceKey` null). `Share` is a fraction of all transports in `Period`.

PickupSourceResponse.description:
One pickup source. `FacilityBased` is false for scene, residence, custodial facility and other, which are never listed by name. `Share` and `PriorShare` are fractions (0 to 1) of all transports,
`ChangePoints` is the move in percentage points. `NetCash` is by posting month, a different basis from the date-of-service counts.

ProviderResponse.description: A Provider the user may see. FacilityCount is how many Facilities they are limited to, and 0 means all of them. The Facility ids stay on the server.

RedeemRequest.description: The token from an emailed link.

RemainderResponse.description: The part of the change no driver explains (USD), how it compares with the usual month-to-month range, and the sentence for it.

ReportingDivisionResponse.description: A Reporting Division: `Key` is stable and is what the `division` parameter takes, `Name` is the warehouse's name for display.

ReportingDivisionsResponse.description: The Reporting Divisions of one Provider.

SavedViewLayout.description: The saved arrangement: a version, a density (`comfortable` or `compact`) and the widgets on a 12-column grid.

SavedViewRequest.description: A view to save. Only these three fields are read: anything else in the body, such as an owner or Provider, is ignored.

SavedViewResponse.description: A view with its layout. `Version` is the same value as the `ETag` header, without the quotes.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

TransportMixByCallTypeResponse.description:
Transports by call type for `Period` and the month before it, by date of service, and a monthly `Trend` over `Months` months (6 or 12).
`TotalTransports` and `PriorTotalTransports` are the sums of the call types.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

TransportsByPickupLocationResponse.description: Transports by pickup source for `Period` and the month before it, by date of service. `Facilities` are the sending facilities of the facility-based sources. Never an address.

TransportVolumeGroupResponse.description:
An aircraft type or level of service: `Key` is stable, `Name` is for display, `ServiceLine` is `air` or `ground`.
`PriorTransports` is the count in the month before the last, `ChangeTransports` the difference and `ChangePercent` that difference in percent units (null when the prior month had none).

TransportVolumePointResponse.description: One month: `Period` is `yyyyMM`, `Transports` the count and `LoadedMiles` the statute miles billed with the patient on board.

dataThrough.description: The date of the warehouse load the figures come from, `yyyy-MM-dd` (Data Through). Null when the Provider has no data in the table the Metric reads.

division.description: The `key` of the Reporting Division the figures are limited to, or null for every division.

divisionName.description: The warehouse's name for that division, or null for every division.

TransportVolumeResponse.description:
Transports and loaded miles by month of service, ending at `EndPeriod`. `Groups` splits the last month by aircraft type or level of service.
`PeriodOpen` is true while the accounting period of the last month is open, so transports for it may still be added.

WhatChangedResponse.description:
What changed in posted net cash (USD) for `Period` against `PriorPeriod`. `DeltaRatio` is the change as a share of last month's cash (-0.22 is a 22% fall),
null when last month had none. `Headline` is the one-sentence summary. `DataThrough` is the date of the warehouse load, `yyyy-MM-dd`.
